threshold_rule: largest validation cutoff with sensitivity >= 0.80; probability >= cutoff; retain ties
bootstrap_strata: patient maximum observed stage within the evaluated scope: operational negative, Stage 1 only, Stage >=2; retain each stratum's patient count
paired_sampling: identical patient multiplicities for both outcomes and all fourteen models within each scope
notes: Primary models, predictions and cutoffs must reproduce the archived Person 5 evaluation; do not refit or tune.
Secondary models were developed after primary test results were available. This freeze precedes this secondary model evaluation, not all historical access to the shared test labels.
Use the same full cohort for both targets: Stage 1 is a secondary negative.
The user-confirmed 80% validation sensitivity rule is applied separately to each target; primary probability cutoffs are never reused for Stage >=2.
Version 1 used unstratified patient-cluster bootstrap. Version 2 explicitly implements the updated request for stratification; intervals may differ, and version 1 artifacts remain unchanged.

S3 is exactly the supplied primary-label-based P2 flag. Its application to the secondary endpoint removes some Stage 1 secondary negatives as well as Stage >=2 positives. It is not redefined as absence of Stage >=2 at first sample.
Intervals condition on fixed fitted models and validation cutoffs, and on patient counts in the three bootstrap strata. No multiplicity adjustment or formal p-value.

Main-test calibration parameters have bootstrap intervals; sensitivity subsets report calibration point estimates only. Undefined statistics are retained as missing and valid replicate counts are reported.
The validation numerical tolerance preserves the existing primary machine-precision tie audit. All probability and ranking discrepancies are recorded without rounding predictions.
